prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In & Keep Your Desktop Pet Safe", "Your pet and progress will automatically sync to your cloud account so you never lose your companion.", "Automatic Pet Progress Backup Enabled"]
1: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a pet to see their interactive desktop animations and personality traits.", "Live Pet Activity Preview"]
2: ["Preparing Your Pet Desktop Environment", "Estimated time remaining: ~3 minutes"]
3: ["Desktop Pet Controls Quick Reference", "Drag your pet anywhere on screen, click to interact, or right-click the system tray icon to adjust pet visibility and settings.", "Start Playing"]
4: ["Select Your Journey", "Scroll through pet companion paths to pick the experience that fits your desktop."]
5: ["Explore Pet Backstories", "Swipe to learn about each companion before making your adoption choice.", "Learn companion quirks and behavior styles"]
6: ["Your Pet is Ready to Join Your Desktop", "Check your main display screen to see your new pet spawn in real time.", "Display Check: Pet active in system tray"]
7: ["Signing in secures your custom pet design to your account storage.", "Cloud Save Active"]
8: ["Use well-lit photos with clear face visibility to ensure accurate pet generation.", "Tip: Bright front-facing photos yield the best 3D pet models."]
9: ["Building Your Desktop Pet", "We are preparing graphics, desktop integration modules, and animations.", "Generating pet assets | Initializing desktop hooks"]
